infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: SkyTwin needs camera access to scan QR codes for pairing with your desktop.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: SkyTwin needs local network access to discover and communicate with the SkyTwin API on your computer.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: SkyTwin uses the microphone for voice input — recorded audio is sent to your paired SkyTwin desktop for on-device transcription and is never uploaded to the cloud.
